executive_pulse: Active campaigns target enterprise identity controls via Okta phishing and North Korean supply-chain poisoning across open-source repositories, while newly disclosed RCE flaws affect llama.cpp and Budibase platforms.

items.headline: GoodGuys Phishing Campaign Impersonates Brands to Target Corporate Okta and Google Logins
items.target: Corporate identity infrastructure / Okta / Google Workspace
items.summary: Ongoing phishing campaign 'GoodGuys' impersonates major brands like Google, Nvidia, and SpaceX using fake webinar and expert interview invitations to capture corporate Google and Okta credentials.
items.action: Enforce strict phishing-resistant FIDO2/WebAuthn MFA across Okta and Google accounts and audit recent single sign-in logs for anomalous device authorizations.
items.hunt: Okta System Log: DebugContext.LogData.ClientIPHost from novel geographic locations combined with prompt authentication requests from external referral domains.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: PolinRider Campaign Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Deliver Malware
items.summary: North Korea-linked threat actors behind PolinRider are planting malicious Python loaders in repository files like conftest.py or utility packages across 7,600+ GitHub repositories to infect developer environments.
items.action: Implement strict dependency pin verification and scan local clone environments/CI scripts for unauthorized obfuscated code imports in conftest.py.
items.hunt: GitHub Actions workflow logs: Execution of unrecognized inline Python loader scripts or suspicious outbound transactions during test suites.

compensating_controls: Reduce exposure: remove internet access to the affected service or interface until patched
Apply vendor-provided mitigations or IPS/WAF signatures where published
remediation.verify: Confirm the installed version on every instance after patching

items.headline: CVE-2026-137567: Heap Out-of-Bounds Write in llama.cpp GGML RPC Server Leads to RCE
items.target: llama.cpp / GGML RPC server / b11450 to before b12658
items.summary: An out-of-bounds write in the ggml RPC server of llama.cpp allows unauthenticated remote attackers to manipulate memory base addresses via zero-element destination tensors and execute code.
items.action: Upgrade llama.cpp to version b12658 or later and restrict RPC server network listener exposure.

compensating_controls: Remove internet exposure of the affected service until patched
Enable platform exploit mitigations and restart the service after patching
remediation.verify: Monitor for crashes or unexpected restarts of the affected service

items.headline: CVE-2026-137498 & CVE-2026-137499: Critical Flaws in Budibase Server Enable Filter Erasure and ATO
items.summary: Budibase Server contains a prototype pollution issue allowing unauthenticated erasure of MongoDB query filters, alongside an unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking vulnerability allowing global account takeovers.
items.action: Upgrade Budibase Server to version 4.0.0 or later.
items.hunt: Budibase access logs: Requests to query execution endpoints containing '__proto__' keys or incoming OIDC callback payloads with 'email_verified: false'.

compensating_controls: Restrict management and admin interfaces to a dedicated admin network or VPN; block them from the internet
Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative access where the product supports it
Rotate admin credentials and API keys, and remove unknown admin accounts
remediation.verify: Review admin and auth logs since the disclosure date for logins without a matching MFA or SSO event

items.headline: ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections: Detection Rules for Agentic AI Attack Frameworks
items.target: Detection Engineering / AI Agent Security / SIEM Detections
items.summary: Repository providing Sigma, KQL, Splunk, Suricata, and YARA detection rules targeting agentic AI attack frameworks such as ARTEX, PentAGI, HexStrike, and Agent Zero.
items.action: Evaluate detection rules in a staging SIEM environment against LLM/Agent execution telemetry.
